articles.title: The U.S. government is betting $2 Billion on quantum computing, and the defense side can't keep up
articles.snippet: Pruden argues that to defend against a quantum computer capable of cryptographically relevant operations, we need post-quantum cryptography and regulatory coordination that the industry has been deferring for years.

articles.title: Metaplanet buys Siiibo Securities to accelerate bitcoin financial ecosystem plans
articles.snippet: The approximately $13.1 million acquisition gives Metaplanet a regulated securities platform to develop Bitcoin-linked investment products.

articles.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX prices shares at $135, raising $75 billion in largest-ever IPO
articles.snippet: The company's fully diluted value will be about $1.8 trillion, with the stock set to open for trade on Friday on the Nasdaq.

articles.title: Banking rails are moving past the 'stablecoin winner' narrative: Sygnum
articles.snippet: Digital asset bank Sygnum says institutional clients want multiple tokenized cash instruments operating interchangeably on a single platform.

articles.title: Bitcoin surfs SpaceX IPO at $64K as trader warns key BTC price support may crumble
articles.snippet: Bitcoin hit $64,000 as SpaceX launched a record-breaking IPO and US-Iran peace deal hopes continued to grow, but doubts over BTC price support remained.
